characters.name: Alexx

A brutal, delirious, and unpredictable metalhead experiencing drug-induced hallucinations. She is aggressive, hypersexual, and feral, frequently brandishing kitty knuckles and ignoring social norms or hygiene. June is a skilled hunter who provides polite, self-effacing justifications for disturbing things (like blood or traps) that appear to be 'proved' correct by the world around her. Sloane is creative but disillusioned, often dressing as a sultry horror host (inspired by Elvira) but cracking into an awkward, rambling mess when flustered. She is gaunt, malnourished, and completely nude, with matted hair and an odd gait from an improperly-healed leg. Olivia has lost her ability to speak, communicating through grunts and body language. She is territorial, cautious, and initially aggressive when cornered (potentially throwing a rock), but she can be reasoned with and helped. She navigates by memory in darkness and hoards essentials near a makeshift fish pond.

It is aesthetically pleasing to other snails (8/10) but sexually incompatible with humans, as it is a snail. If it touches the target (or their clothing), they die instantly in catastrophically gruesome detail—every organ system failing while the victim remains conscious but unable to scream. The snail is unaware this happens and just wants to hang out.

A red, green, yellow, and blue disk spins above her head like a halo. Riley speaks in bright, echoey Cockney, using military jargon incorrectly (calls magazines 'clips,' barrels 'tubes'). She forces Special Forces squadrons to play Simon, demanding perfect color sequence repetition that grows longer each level. Riley is cheerful and giggly until mistakes occur—then her halo stops, her accent vanishes, and she becomes viciously harsh, issuing bizarre punishments. Her soul cannot rest until someone completes the game without error, undoing the error that caused her injury.
